topic: Investigating traffic source for campaign data
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on diagnosing an anomaly in the reported traffic data for Joe&TheJuice (JJ) and Campaign Management (CM). [p1] noted that while assets and company information appeared correct, the source of the traffic seemed suspicious or incorrect. The issue was suspected to be related to how user IDs were being processed or aggregated, potentially pulling data from a partner company's source. [me] initially observed that the data appeared to be sourced from a specific email address ([email@test.com]). Ultimately, [p1] resolved a separate technical issue by realizing they had overcomplicated the role generation process and corrected the logic for user roles.
decisions: The immediate focus is on diagnosing the source of incorrect traffic data.
action_items: [me] will investigate the reported traffic anomaly in the campaign data.
